description: Mobile identity (Expo app). Issue 1 cosmetic: relabel the login identifier field. Issue 6 (mobile half): a one-time, non-nagging 'Complete your profile' gate that collects a 10-digit mobile, verifies it via the FEAT-001 email-OTP endpoints, and refreshes the session. Placeholder detection is extracted into a pure helper so it is unit-testable under the mobile node:test harness (which cannot render React screens). Depends on FEAT-001's /users/mobile/send + /users/mobile/verify endpoints.
steps: Add mobile/src/profileGate.ts exporting `export function needsRealMobile(user: { mobile?: string | null } | null | undefined): boolean` that returns false for a null/undefined user, else returns !/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(String(user.mobile || '')) so the Google 'g<digits>' placeholder and any empty/short value return true and a real 10-digit mobile returns false. Keep it dependency-free (no React, no api import) so the test harness can load it.

Add mobile/src/__tests__/profileGate.test.ts following the style of src/__tests__/addresses.test.ts (import test from 'node:test', assert from 'node:assert/strict', import { needsRealMobile } from '../profileGate.ts'). Cover: null user -> false; { mobile: '9876543210' } -> false; { mobile: 'g1234567890' } (placeholder) -> true; { mobile: '' } -> true; { mobile: undefined } -> true; a non-starting-digit like '1234567890' -> true.

In mobile/app/login.tsx, in the mode === 'login' branch, change the Field label from 'Username or Mobile' to 'Username, Mobile or Email' and add keyboardType="email-address". No logic change — the value is still passed as-is to useAuth().login.

Add mobile/app/complete-profile.tsx — an expo-router screen reusing the UI components from app/login.tsx (Screen, Card, Field, GradientButton, Button, StoreHeader) and the email-OTP interaction pattern (a 'Send code' button that calls api.post('/users/mobile/send'), then an OTP Field + a verify button that calls api.post('/users/mobile/verify', { mobile, otp })). On verify success call useAuth().reloadSession() then router.replace('/'). Collect a 10-digit mobile with maxLength 10 and the same /\D/g strip used in login.tsx. Show apiError(e) messages. Do not auto-fill the OTP (match login.tsx behavior).

In mobile/app/_layout.tsx, add a trigger: after `ready` is true and a user exists, if needsRealMobile(user) then router.replace('/complete-profile') exactly once per app launch. Guard with a useRef boolean (e.g. gatedRef) so it fires at most once and never loops; subscribe to the user via useAuth so that once a valid mobile is set (reloadSession) the gate is not shown again. Do not block or redirect when the mobile is already valid.
Commit locally on branch identity-checkout-fixes (do not push).
acceptance_criteria: mobile/src/profileGate.ts exports needsRealMobile with the specified truth table and imports nothing from React/api.
npm test includes passing cases for profileGate (valid mobile false; 'g...' placeholder true; empty/undefined true; null user false).
login.tsx login-mode Field reads 'Username, Mobile or Email' with keyboardType email-address and no logic change.
app/complete-profile.tsx exists and wires /users/mobile/send + /users/mobile/verify and calls reloadSession() on success.
_layout.tsx redirects to /complete-profile at most once per launch only when needsRealMobile(user) is true, and never when the mobile is valid.

findings:
DONE. Mobile files added/edited in 4astore-v2/mobile:

(1) src/profileGate.ts — exports `needsRealMobile(user: { mobile?: string | null } | null | undefined): boolean`. Returns false for null/undefined user; else `!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(String(user.mobile || ''))`. Dependency-free (no React, no api import) so the node:test harness loads it. Truth table verified: null/undefined -> false; '9876543210' -> false; 'g1234567890' -> true; '' -> true; undefined mobile -> true; '1234567890' -> true.

(2) src/__tests__/profileGate.test.ts — node:test cases for all 6 rows above. All pass.

(3) app/login.tsx — login-mode Field relabeled 'Username or Mobile' -> 'Username, Mobile or Email' and added keyboardType="email-address". No logic change; value still passed as-is to useAuth().login.

(4) app/complete-profile.tsx — expo-router gate screen reusing Screen/Card/Field/GradientButton/Button + StoreHeader. 'Send code' button posts api.post('/users/mobile/send', {}) (requireAuth; access token sent automatically via api.ts authHeaders()); then an Email OTP Field + 'Verify & Continue' posts api.post('/users/mobile/verify', { mobile, otp }). On success calls useAuth().reloadSession() then router.replace('/'). Mobile uses maxLength 10 + the same /\D/g strip as login.tsx; OTP uses /\D/g strip + maxLength 6 and is NEVER auto-filled (matches login.tsx; server devOtp ignored). Errors shown via apiError(e). NOTE for later steps: this screen does not read the response body — it relies on the thrown ApiError (api.ts throws when success===false) for failures and reloadSession() to pull the updated user; so the server envelope shape ({success,data:{user}}) is not consumed here.

(5) app/_layout.tsx — subscribed to the full `user` via useAuth (was only user?.id/role) and added a gate effect: when `ready` && user && needsRealMobile(user), router.replace('/complete-profile'). Guarded by a useRef boolean (gatedRef) set true before navigating so it fires at most once per launch and never loops. Because it subscribes to `user`, once reloadSession sets a real 10-digit mobile needsRealMobile becomes false and the gate never shows again; a valid mobile never triggers a redirect.

VERIFICATION (worktree 4astore-v2/mobile): `npm test` -> 45/45 pass incl. the 6 new profileGate cases (tests 45, pass 45, fail 0). `npm run typecheck` -> tsc --noEmit exits 0 with ZERO errors (no new errors; the known android.usesCleartextTraffic config-types error did not surface in this install).

ENV NOTE: the worktree's mobile/ had no node_modules, so `tsc` was missing. I ran `npm install` (800 packages, no prisma/SSL issues on mobile) in 4astore-v2/mobile to get the typescript toolchain + type defs; node_modules is gitignored and not committed.

ENDPOINTS consumed (from FEAT-001): POST /users/mobile/send (body {}) and POST /users/mobile/verify (body { mobile: /^[6-9]\d{9}$/, otp: /^\d{6}$/ }), both requireAuth with the bearer access token attached by api.ts.
